passage:
Ryan forgot his jacket on the coldest day of winter. He tried to act normal, but his hands were shaking.
During lunch, a classmate named Owen gave him a jacket. Ryan was surprised because they were not close friends.
"Why" Ryan asked.
Owen said, "Someone helped me last year when I forgot mine."
Ryan wore the jacket all afternoon. The next day, he returned it with a thank-you note.
Weeks later, Ryan saw a younger student standing outside without a coat. He remembered Owen and offered his own jacket.
The jacket had not only kept him warm. It had also carried a simple message from one person to another: help does not have to stop with the person who receives it.
